Algorithm

1. Initialize cluster centroids \mu_1, \mu_2, \dots, \mu_k \in \mathbb{R}^n randomly.

2. Repeat until convergence: {

For every i, set

c^{(i)} := \arg\min_{j} ||x^{(i)} - \mu_j||^2.

For each j, set

\mu_j := \frac{\sum_{i=1}^m 1\{c^{(i)} = j\}x^{(i)}}{\sum_{i=1}^m 1\{c^{(i)} = j\}}.

}
